note: City of Hoisington RV sites in a row along the east edge of the asphalt parking lot behind the activity center (1200 Susank Rd) on the north edge of town; dump station on the north side of the lot. Self-register and pay at the drop box. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $20 a night in July 2025 and May 2026 (Campendium); the city's listing gives no rate. --Claude
summary: City page is a bare listing (name, address, phone 620-653-4134 = stored). Fees $20 kept but now camper-reported (Campendium 2025-07 and 2026-05); electric 50 + water and 12 back-in sites from Campendium reports (pull_through true -> false). Pin on the activity-center roof, ~140 m west of the sites: move to 38.5243,-98.7720. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PRICE SOURCE (a judgment call): the city does have a web page, but it is a one-line listing (name, address, phone) with no rate, so I priced from the dated Campendium camper reports ($20, 2026-05-26 and 2025-07-13) with a CAMPER-REPORTED RATE note line. If the 'operator has no web page' condition is read strictly, clear fees instead; the stored $20 had rested only on our own note.

PIN (apply.py doesn't write it): 38.52434,-98.77358 is on the activity-center building. The RV sites are the row of hookup posts on the east edge of the east parking lot, centre ~38.5243,-98.7720 (~140 m east; Google's point 38.52442,-98.77200 is on that row). Propose 38.5243,-98.7720.

HOOKUPS/SITES from camper reports only (Campendium): electric 50 (posts '50/30/110'), water at the site, 12 sites, back-in. Pull-through changed true -> false: Campendium says 'back-in', and on imagery the stalls back off the lot edge (a rig could likely pull in nose-first across the lot, so this is soft).

BOOKING not written: the 2021 Campendium summary ('info provided by city') says 'No reservations, first come, first served', self-pay at an iron ranger, 'Maximum stay: 6 nights' - older than 2024 and not on any city page, so left out. The phone (620) 653-4134 is the number the city lists.

OWNERSHIP local confirmed (the city lists it; Campendium 'City camping facility'); RV Life's 'commercial' type is wrong. Ratings: Google 4.4/21, RV Life 3.5/4 (local, so the private under-4 rule doesn't apply).
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' confirmed: asphalt lot between farm fields at the north edge of town.
SAND: none - asphalt lot with a gravel strip at the posts.
